Lush and silky timbre, unhurried tempo, softly elongated vowels and a breathy, playful sweet-spoiled lilt at the ends of phrases, effortlessly charming and at ease.
Speak immediately in Japanese. Say exactly this line once: "ここは割り勘よ。". Do not translate, paraphrase, repeat, or add words. Then remain silent. Stop completely silent immediately after the final syllable; no trailing breath, sigh, hum, or background noise.
